sentences.text: 04.02.2026 (M. Zothankhuma, J) Page No.# 2/2 Ms. N. Hassan, learned counsel appears for the appellant, who has been convicted under Section 376(1) of IPC vide judgment and order dated 08.07.2024, passed by the learned Addl. Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Tinsukia in POCSO Case No.91/2023 arising out of Digboi P.S. Case No.120/2023.
Mr. R.R. Kaushik, learned A.P.P. accepts notice on behalf of the State respondent.

6. The appellant shall serve a soft copy of the appeal to the office of the Public Prosecutor, Assam,
who shall thereafter furnish the same to the O/C of the concerned Police Station.
The O/C shall serve the copy of the appeal to the respondent No.2 and make a report of the same thereafter.
7. As per the impugned judgment, the victim had apparently become pregnant and as the impugned judgment had been passed on 08.07.2024, a child should have been born by now.

8. The learned counsels for the parties shall obtain instructions as to whether the appellant and the child born to the victim should have a DNA Profiling Test done to verify as to whether the appellant is the father of the child.
